clips.send: A shopper sends it to a friend who takes gummy vitamins every morning, mild alarm.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau held up two supplement labels on his show: a plain capsule and a gummy vitamin.

The capsule's label was short - pure apple cider vinegar, no fillers. The gummy needed sugar, gelatin and extra additives just to hold its shape.

His own view: gummies are the worst way to take a vitamin, because of what has to go in them to make them chewable.

Next time you're in the vitamin aisle, flip the bottle over first.

What's actually in the supplement you take every morning?
